items.description:

items.description:
Perhaps the most successful political trick that’s been played in Pakistan has been to make people believe that survival is a personal responsibility.

items.description:
THE Prime Minister’s Committee on Civil Service Reforms has finalised its core recommendations, yet omitted any clear roadmap for the Planning Commission.
